title: Tenure / App experience — Tabler Icons migration across 13 mobile screens
summary: Promoted 17 Tabler Icons (MIT) as named components in the Tenure / Components > Mobile > Icons sub-section, replacing all hand-built Unicode and rectangle-based icons across the mobile experience. Swapped 52 tab-bar icons (Home/Tasks/People/Profile × 13 screens), 13 chevron-right list-row affordances, 3 arrow-up-right external-nav affordances, and 6 task-completion check glyphs. All stroke colours use canonical Stratum hex values: ochre-link #7a3d0a (7.14:1 AAA on paper) for active/interactive icons, ink-mute-aa #404755 (7.93:1 AAA on paper) for inactive/decorative icons. Status-bar icons (cellular, wifi, battery) kept as iOS-canonical vectors per scope decision.

status_bar_disposition: iOS-canonical status bar icons (cellular bars, wifi arc, battery rectangle) kept unchanged. These represent OS chrome, not app content. Switching to Tabler would break the iPhone fiction — Tabler is not an OS icon set. Decision: keep as-is.
sentiment_marks_disposition: Fraunces ◎ ◌ ○ glyphs in App 04 Check-in emoji row and App 07 Sentiment check kept unchanged. These are editorial typographic sentiment indicators, not iconographic UI controls. Tabler circle-dot/circle-dashed/circle would read as UI state toggles, not as affect gradations. Keeping the Fraunces glyphs preserves the editorial register. Noted as a judgment call.
em_dash_disposition: JetBrains Mono em-dash (—) in compensation/rating/paycheck rows kept unchanged. These are textual 'no-data-yet' placeholders in the typography system, not icons.

accessibility.touch_targets: Icon components are 24×24px per SC 2.5.8 minimum. List-row touch targets are 64×390pt (far exceeds 44pt AAA). Tab cells are 83×97pt. All icons meet or exceed SC 2.5.8.
accessibility.non_text_contrast: All icon strokes pass SC 1.4.11 (≥3:1 on their respective backgrounds) — ochre-link and ink-mute-aa both clear 7:1 which is above the 3:1 floor.
accessibility.wcag_o1: This dispatch advances O-1: (1) Tabler SVG paths are VECTOR nodes with defined stroke semantics — more reliable for screen-reader accessibility tooling than Unicode text characters whose announced names are typographic, not semantic. (2) Consistent 24×24 icon sizing across all 13 screens eliminates the 81×24 and 173×24 oversized tab icon frames that would confuse touch-target computation. (3) AAA contrast preserved on both active (ochre-link 7.14:1) and inactive (ink-mute-aa 7.93:1) stroke colours. (4) All icon frames named descriptively (Tabler home, Tabler checks, etc.) rather than generic 'Frame' — improves layer-tree accessibility for design handoff.

All raw hexes exactly match: ochre-link #7a3d0a, ink-mute-aa #404755. Gap: 'Bootstrap Colour variable collection from tenure/index.html :root block' — out of scope for this dispatch, surfaced for next token sprint.
side_effects: Task completion glyph (173×24 '/ \' two-rectangle frame) replaced with 24×24 Tabler checks — layout parent rows now have 149px of new whitespace at the trailing edge where the oversized frame was. This is correct; the checks icon is 24×24, which is the intended size. The 173×24 was an oversized artifact from the hand-built approach.
Chevron frames grew from 16×16 to 24×24 — each was offset by -4px in both axes to maintain visual center. No layout shifts detected in screenshots.
ship_verdict: The icon system now reads consistently across all 13 screens. One icon family. One set of semantics. One stroke weight. Typography-grade restraint: no filled icons, no color noise. The tab bar and list rows are the most-seen surfaces in the mobile experience — both are now clean.
